prompt: Photorealistic product rendering, true side view, of a manual tri-star stair hand truck leaning back climbing domestic stairs, on a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop. Tall twin-tube aluminium backbone diagonal from low axle up to extended telescoping steel push handle at top. Large cardboard parcel strapped to backbone sitting on horizontal folding steel toe-plate at the foot. At the base, a steel main axle carrying two tri-star wheel clusters, each cluster is a triangular steel plate with three small solid rubber wheels, one wheel on flat tread and one pivoting over the concrete step nose. Steel disc rotor with tooth lock visible on axle side with caliper. Dead-man steel brake lever under handle grip with black cable running down alongside backbone with slack loop to caliper. Clip strap of polyester webbing around parcel to backbone. Only a small patch of two light concrete stair steps under wheels and toe, cut off cleanly at the backdrop for scale, stair riser about one sixth of truck height, parcel about half of truck height. Real materials, matte aluminium, dark rubber, brushed steel, brown cardboard, product-shot softbox lighting, sharp focus on mechanism. Fixed backbone and toe versus rotating tri-star clusters and pivoting handle clearly readable. Add short clean callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each visible part: Twin Tube Backbone, Folding Toe Plate, Tri Star Cluster, Main Cluster Axle, Disc Tooth Brake, Dead Man Lever, Telescoping Push Handle, no other text.
must_not: tools and clutter and extra boxes
powered motors and skids and single pole frame
large text blocks and titles and scale bars
changes_from_previous: Initial version - no previous rendering, built directly from solution and hand sketches.

visual_plan.view: True side elevation, full truck plus parcel plus two steps in frame, deployed tilted working posture
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Side profile left to right: parcel on toe-plate at lower left, vertical backbone rising diagonally to upper right to extended handle; axle and disc brake low center just above lower step; tri-star clusters straddling the step nose; two concrete steps forming small L patch under device only, vast empty light-grey backdrop around for callout tags.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Mid-climb operating moment tipped back pulling upstairs: parcel secured on toe-plate, lower tri-star cluster pivoting over step nose while upper wheels still on lower tread, disc plus tooth lock holding slope load, handle pulled up and lever squeezed to meter.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Load path: folding toe-plate -> twin-tube backbone -> main cluster axle -> tri-star wheel cluster -> stair step; Control path: dead-man lever -> cable -> disc tooth brake -> axle lock, release to move, release handle to auto-lock.
visual_plan.interactions: Parcel weight sits down on folding toe-plate, hinge transfers to twin-tube backbone; strap preloads parcel back against backbone; backbone bends to main cluster axle; axle carries twin tri-star clusters to step treads; telescoping handle slides inside backbone tubes; dead-man lever pulls cable with slack loop to disc caliper and tooth pin on axle to hold or meter rotation.
